text: Eredar Demolishers are eredar brutes encountered by Class Hall champions in Antoran Wastes.

__NOTOC__ Erynna is a dryad located at Shady Sanctuary and the Mane Squeeze in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Ergburk is a turtle located in the Ohn'ahran Plains during Grand Hunts.

Eroded Stone Elementals are small earth elementals located in the waters of Thunder Ridge in Durotar during the Heritage of Draenor questline. Translucent and uninteractable versions move around the area in groups, while hostile versions can spawn upon interacting with Buried Seeds during The Spirit of Thunder Ridge (quest).
Escaped Crabs are crabs that escape from a Crate of Crabs in Razor Hill in Durotar.
Erna is a Winterpelt furbolg located at Winterpelt Hollow in the Azure Span.
__NOTOC__ Erkhart Stormvein is a jungle troll located in Ruby Life Pools.
Erza is a dracthyr item upgrader located in the Sapphire Enclave in Valdrakken.
Ergruy is a green drakonid located at Eon's Fringe in Thaldraszus.
Escar-Go-Go-Go is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating Magmorax after feeding him 20 Spicy Lava Snails in Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible on Normal difficulty or higher.
Escaped Fish are dead fish located in the Zskera Vaults in the Forbidden Reach. They can be thrown into a nearby Unkept Aquarium and revitalized with Restorative Water.
Eric's Camera is provided as an objective for Lost Time-Lost Vikings.

The Escaped Dracthyr are dead dracthyr located at the Old Weyrn Grounds in the Forbidden Reach. After being released from stasis, they escaped their weyrns, only to be hunted down by the Spellsworn Wingcatcher.
Essence Devourer is a priest class talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Void Shift.
Erupting Shadowflame is a fire elemental located in Zaqali Caldera in Zaralek Cavern. It is spawned by Fyrakk at Sabellian and Ebyssian.
Erethos, the Empty Promise drops from Scalecommander Sarkareth in Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible.
Ermmglmrr is a murloc from Azmerloth located in Tyrhold Reservoir in Thaldraszus during Time Rifts.
Ermmglmrr III is a murloc from Azmerloth located in Tyrhold Reservoir in Thaldraszus during Time Rifts.
Ermmglmrr Jr. is a murloc from Azmerloth located in Tyrhold Reservoir in Thaldraszus during Time Rifts.
Erik Olof Gunnar Andersson, a Lead Server Engineer at Blizzard Entertainment, began his tenure as a Technical Support Agent, advancing through various positions to reach his current role.
Erin Fitzgerald is a voice actress who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft and its various expansions.
Erica Horita, alias Erie, is the drawer of Warrior: Divided.
Essence of Undeath is an elemental building block of many crafting recipes. It adds the virtues of death and darkness to any item.
Essence of the Firelord is a component needed to make Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker.
Essence of the Pure Flame drops from Ragnaros, final boss of the Molten Core.
Etched Tanzanite is an epic gem that fits a red or blue socket.

Eternal Ember drops from Raging Flames, Flame Revenants, and enemy Alliance and Horde players at the Cauldron of Flames in Wintergrasp. Each member of a party or raid group can loot this item from a body if they have the quest.

Essence of Wintergrasp is a buff that is available for every player in Northrend, as long as the faction controls Wintergrasp. Players under the effect of the buff receive 5% more experience. While in Wintergrasp, players are able to see greater elemental spirits, which have a 100% chance to drop the following items: * Crystallized Air * Crystallized Shadow * Crystallized Fire * Crystallized Water * Crystallized Earth
__NOTOC__ Estulan is a Highborne night elf located in Tower of Estulan in Feralas, and within Dire Maul as well.
Eternal Elementium Handguards are created with Blacksmithing (525); taught by Plans: Eternal Elementium Handguards.

__NOTOC__ Eternal Champions are Highborne elven members of the Queen's Royal Guard, an order led by Captain Varo'then. They were found on the glass terrace of Azshara's Palace in the Well of Eternity dungeon. They are also found in The Deaths of Chromie scenario dropping Sands of Time.
__NOTOC__ Et'kil is a stationary mantid hiding in the southwest corner of one of the nooks of the Niuzao Temple exterior in the Townlong Steppes.
Eternal Blossoms can be found alongside the river flowing from Mistfall Village to Whitepetal Lake in central Vale of Eternal Blossoms. They contain Delicate Blossom Petals.

The Eternal Battlefield is the largest sub-region of Helheim. In Helheim, the spirits of the dishonorable spend eternity in an endless futile battle, always seeking glory but never able to attain it. This manifests in a futile struggle against an undead giant known as Geir. During the Trial of Valor, Guarm and the road he guards are part of the Eternal Battlefield.
The Essence of Magmus drops from Magmus in Blackrock Depths.
Essence of Nordrassil is a Restoration druid artifact trait. It is linked to the Nature's Essence, Armor of the Ancients and Dreamwalker (druid artifact trait) traits.
Etched in Shadow is a Subtlety rogue artifact trait. It is linked to the Shadows of the Uncrowned and Shadow's Whisper traits.
The Essence of Light is provided as an objective for An Offering of Light.
Eternal Conservator are crystal dryads located in Invasion Point: Bonich.
Eternal Bride is a banshee located in Forever Rise in Azsuna. Nar'thalas Citizens are watching her and Eternal Groom as if they were being wed.
Eternal Groom is a spectre located in Forever Rise in Azsuna. Nar'thalas Citizens are watching him and Eternal Bride as if they were being wed.

An Etched Drust Bone is an archaeology keystone. It acts as ... Drust Archaeology Fragments in research on Drust archaeology finds that have 'sockets'.
Essences of Nightmare are haunts located in the Clutch of Corruption in the Emerald Nightmare. They roam in packs of seven.
Essence of the Mists is a Mistweaver monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Mists of Wisdom and Spirit Tether traits.
Esteemed is a title rewarded for obtaining 100 Exalted Reputations. The title will show before the character's name, in the following format: :Esteemed

Eternal Curse of Zem'lan is a debuff that is applied to every player and NPC found at the Port of Zem'lan and the Golden Isle of Vol'dun.

The Etched Bone Trophy of the Vanquished can be purchased for 500 Honor from in Boralus or in Zuldazar after having a PvP rating of at least 1,000 in the previous week. Infusing the item at the Heart Forge will grant Rank 2 of the Conflict and Strife Essence and leave behind a Split Bone.

The Essence of Maldraxxus is found in Glutharn's Decay in Maldraxxus.

The Eternal Forge is an area of northern Bastion that serves as a center of production and assembly for many kyrian weapons used by the Ascended. Here, various forms of centurions are forged by the stewards to defend the realm against attack. The facility also hosts a shrine to the First Forgelite, in which sits the legendary hammer known as :Phaestus, Genesis of Aeons.
Establishing the Archive concludes the "Archivists of Korthia" side chapter of the Chains of Domination campaign, but the reputation grind continues.

The Estuary of Awakening lies between the Windswept Aerie to the south and Hope's Ascent to the north in southwestern Korthia. The area has been overrun by devourers, feasting on both the anima and the razorwings.

Eternal Bulwarks are goliaths that participate in the assault on the House of Constructs during Righteous Retribution/ A Golden Dawn. One is initially seen outside the Hall of Chains, helping Apolon hold the line against Soulspliced Veterans heading up the stairs from the Separation Chamber. Later, during The End is Now (Kyrian)/The End is Now (Necrolord) and Pursuit of Justice (Kyrian)/Pursuit of Justice (Necrolord), a number of Eternal Bulwarks can be seen in the area around the House of Constructs' central ripening pond, fighting various Construct forces.
